skill.summary: Organize security assessment, remediation, hardening, validation, and monitoring through a phased defense-in-depth workflow.

content.value_statement: Security programs often separate scanning, remediation, validation, and compliance work. This skill organizes those activities into a phased defense-in-depth workflow.
actual_capabilities: Coordinates SAST, DAST, dependency, secret, and supply-chain assessments.
Structures threat modeling with STRIDE, MITRE ATT&CK, attack trees, and risk prioritization.
Plans remediation for application, mobile, authentication, infrastructure, and secrets-management weaknesses.
Defines validation activities using penetration testing and security-control effectiveness checks.
Maps verification work to OWASP, CIS, SOC 2, privacy, healthcare, and payment standards.
Outlines SIEM integration, event correlation, alerting, dashboards, and incident-response playbooks.
limitations: The skill depends on external security tools and specialized agents that may not be available.
It does not provide legal authorization for scanning, exploitation, or infrastructure changes.
Generated fixes and compliance conclusions require environment-specific testing and expert review.
Intrusive testing can disrupt systems and requires explicit scope, rollback plans, and stop conditions.

use_cases.title: Establish a Security Baseline
use_cases.description: Coordinate initial scanning, threat modeling, and architecture review for a new or inherited application.

use_cases.title: Build a DevSecOps Program
use_cases.description: Prioritize vulnerabilities, apply layered controls, and integrate security tests into delivery workflows.

use_cases.title: Prepare Compliance Evidence
use_cases.description: Organize control validation, gap analysis, monitoring requirements, and evidence for selected frameworks.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Security Baseline
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess [system] using non-intrusive methods. Identify application, dependency, secret, and configuration risks, then prioritize findings by impact and likelihood.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner assessment for a defined application

prompt_templates.title: Plan Vulnerability Remediation
prompt_templates.prompt: Using these authorized findings: [findings], create a remediation plan for [system]. Include owners, validation steps, rollback requirements, and priority rationale.

prompt_templates.title: Design Layered Security Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Design defense-in-depth controls for [architecture]. Cover identity, application, data, network, secrets, monitoring, and delivery pipelines. Note assumptions and unresolved risks.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate an Authorized Security Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Coordinate a phased security program for [scope] under [authorization]. Respect [exclusions], [testing window], and [stop conditions]. Produce assessment, remediation, validation, compliance, and monitoring deliverables.

output_examples.input: Assess a customer portal before its production launch.
output_examples.output: A prioritized baseline covering code, dependencies, secrets, architecture, and exposed interfaces, followed by owners and validation steps for each major risk.

output_examples.input: Harden authentication for a regulated financial application.
output_examples.output: An identity plan covering OIDC with PKCE, phishing-resistant MFA, least-privilege authorization, secure sessions, audit events, rollout controls, and rollback criteria.

output_examples.input: Prepare a SOC 2 security validation program.
output_examples.output: A control-to-evidence plan with identified gaps, responsible teams, monitoring requirements, validation activities, and items requiring independent auditor confirmation.

best_practices: Define written authorization, scope, exclusions, testing windows, rollback plans, and stop conditions before starting.
Prioritize findings using technical severity, exploitability, business impact, and exposure.
Validate every remediation in a controlled environment before production deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not run intrusive scanners or exploits against systems without explicit authorization.
Do not treat generated compliance conclusions as formal certification or legal advice.
Do not apply broad hardening changes without testing compatibility, observability, and rollback procedures.

faq.question: Does this skill run security tools directly?
faq.answer: It coordinates specialized agents and named tools. Actual execution depends on the available environment, integrations, credentials, and permissions.

faq.question: Can I use it against production systems?
faq.answer: Only with explicit authorization, a defined scope, tested rollback procedures, monitoring, and clear stop conditions. Prefer controlled environments for intrusive work.

faq.question: Which security assessments does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers static, dynamic, dependency, secret, supply-chain, architecture, threat-modeling, penetration-testing, and compliance-oriented assessments.

faq.question: Which compliance frameworks are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow references OWASP ASVS, CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, and PCI DSS when applicable.

faq.question: Does it guarantee that a system is secure?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on tool coverage, system access, current threat information, implementation quality, and independent validation.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best results?
faq.answer: Provide architecture details, repositories, deployed interfaces, data classifications, authorization boundaries, compliance goals, existing findings, and operational constraints.
